integrity: The supplied exact-arithmetic checker verifies the one-dimensional rational witness. Infinite-dimensional spectral assertions require the analytic variational and perturbation proof; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic positive smooth spatial environments and principal linear invasion spectra only; a uniform post-harvest capacity loss is required for the unique cutoff. Nonlinear global competition, general spatial capacity reductions and stochastic establishment are not established.
title: The sharp uniform-disadvantage and mobility frontier for resident-mimicking dispersal
